labelOrigin: author-defined synthetic specification, not independent human annotation

changes.subject: feat: validate package manifests before uploading
changes.body: Reject manifests with missing names before the upload begins.

notes.text: Package manifests are validated before uploading; missing names stop the upload.
The package browser now supports a compact list layout.

labels.rationale: Both messages specify pre-upload manifest/name validation.

changes.subject: fix: close idle sockets after sixty seconds

notes.text: Idle sockets close after sixty seconds.
Connection errors now include the destination hostname.

labels.rationale: Identical idle socket timeout behavior and duration.

notes.text: Artifact names can be sorted alphabetically.
Preview images use a neutral background.

labels.rationale: Both describe the same artifact-name ordering option.

changes.subject: fix: retain debugger sessions after transient transport failure

notes.text: A brief connection interruption no longer throws away your debugging work.
Breakpoints can be exported to a text file.

labels.rationale: A transport interruption and a brief connection interruption describe the same trigger; session retention is the outcome.

changes.subject: fix: preserve existing output when generated filenames collide

notes.text: Generating a file with an already-used name leaves the original file intact.
Templates accept a custom indentation width.

labels.rationale: Both describe preventing replacement of an existing file after a name collision.

changes.subject: feat: resume interrupted task batches from their checkpoint

notes.text: Restart a stopped batch where it left off instead of repeating completed work.
Task labels may now contain emoji.

labels.rationale: Resuming at the checkpoint and avoiding repeated completed tasks describe the same capability.

changes.subject: feat: lint configuration supports per-directory overrides

notes.text: The diagnostic panel remembers its width.
Error messages include the source line number.

labels.rationale: Neither supplied note mentions directory-specific configuration.

changes.subject: feat: compress backup archives with zstd

notes.text: Backup progress shows the count of scanned folders.
The help page includes examples for restoring a single file.

labels.rationale: Progress/help changes do not document the compression format.

changes.subject: fix: cap retry attempts at two

notes.text: Retry attempts are capped at ten.
Request logs include the response content type.

labels.rationale: The retry count in the closest-looking note contradicts the specified count.

notes.text: Searching documentation now requires an active internet connection.
The navigation sidebar supports nested sections.

labels.rationale: Offline search and requiring an active connection are opposite behavior.

notes.text: Choose which fields appear in the exported table.
Customize the set of columns included in a table export.
Reports can be saved in a dedicated output folder.

labels.rationale: Two equivalent notes cover the same option; a reviewer should resolve duplicate/competing wording.

changes.subject: fix: make build warnings easier to understand

notes.text: Build warnings now explain the cause more clearly.
Warning messages from builds give clearer explanations.
The output directory can be selected per job.

labels.rationale: Both warning explanations are plausible counterparts; no unique choice is specified.
